title: Version 1.18.0
body:
Version 1.1.8.0

July 5th, 2023

New Content:

  • Added the long awaited Trapezoid Schematic! Can be used to make hexagons
  • Added flag pole for 4th of July, this will not be limited
  • Added glass hatch, can be used for glass windows and trapdoors!

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed issue with certain boxes (glass door, flat door, etc) displaying purchase value after being bought

Version 1.18.1

July 5th, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed Elevator interaction not working when large
  • Fixed Architect gamepass not giving new schematic
